race.comment: WILD ROMEO (2) led into the straight last start over 1100m at Armidale but could not sustain the pressure and finished eighth. Likely to push forward and race on the pace. expected to go close from the good draw. COMMEDIA (4) was in the money at Port Macquarie when resuming two runs back then could only manage fourth at Moree over 950m three weeks ago. Blinkers added this time. Shapes as one of the top chances. PIE CHART (7) returns after three-and-a-half months in the paddock. Closed the last campaign with a ninth over 1250m at Gunnedah. Good effort to kick-off last prep when in the money at Walgett over 900m. One of the leading chances. STAINLESS STEEL (8) wasn't far off maiden success before a lengthy spell, finishing the prep with a minor placing at Grafton. Can pick up where he left off. Rates highly on best form and should be in the mix.
